item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses two `dspy.LM` instances with the same `api_base`, one `model_type=\"chat\"` and one `model_type=\"text\"`, then calls `forward` on both."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the chat capture contains `messages == [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"ping\"}]` when only `prompt=\"ping\"` is passed."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.completion` for chat, records the outbound request, and verifies that the captured chat call still carries the `messages` payload."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.text_completion` for text and asserts the outbound prompt is exactly `ping\\n\\nBEGIN RESPONSE:`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the text-side model is rewritten to `text-completion-openai/my-text-model` before LiteLLM text completion."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Captures explicit `api_base` forwarding on the text path and verifies the same fake endpoint is used; chat capture also includes the same `api_base` in the recorded request."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
